data.description: NASA Galileo spacecraft took this image of Earth moon on December 7, 1992 on its way to explore the Jupiter system in 1995-97. The distinct bright ray crater at the bottom of the image is the Tycho impact basin.  http://photojournal.jpl.nasa.gov/catalog/PIA00405
